story:
Why this one matters: Flushing Meadows is finished. London is next. Sky Sports will show Laver Cup from Friday 25 September to Sunday 27 September at The O2.

Wikipedia, rankings as of 14 September: Team Europe is Alexander Zverev, Carlos Alcaraz, Flavio Cobolli, Rafael Jódar, Jakub Menšík, Casper Ruud. Team World is Brandon Nakashima, Alex de Minaur, Taylor Fritz, Learner Tien, Alexander Bublik, Francisco Cerúndolo. Shelton withdrew 17 September. Tommy Paul withdrew 12 September.

Format: Friday wins one point, Saturday two, Sunday three. First to 13. Captains Yannick Noah and Andre Agassi. Do not print a 2026 Laver Cup champion. The matches have not been played.
stakes: The first team tennis date after the US Open. A listed roster is not a trophy.
rivalryAngle: Europe against the rest of the world, in a building that already hosted this event in 2022.
